subject: Partner sandbox credit pass-through — CloudSphere integration
messages:
From: Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@cloudsphere.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: revops@cloudsphere.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: partner-issued sandbox credits for CloudSphere PLG integration

Hi Lauren,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're kicking off a closed beta of the CloudSphere + Redwood connector next week and would like to issue partner-sponsored sandbox credits to the first ~250 signups that come through our marketplace flow. The intent is to let new devs try Redwood capabilities inside CloudSphere-managed environments before they convert to paid accounts.

Quick details: we expect ~250 redemptions over 4 weeks, avg usage ~20k tokens/month per trial, single-use promo code per account. Attached is a CSV with partner identifiers and the proposed credit balance. We need a pass-through activation (CloudSphere issues, Redwood redeems) or a mechanism you prefer.

Please let me know required fields (SKU, promo code format, redemption window) and any security or billing gating we should plan for. We're on a tight timeline — can we get engineering ops sign-off by EOD Wednesday PST?

Thanks,
Anika Sharma
Partnerships Manager — CloudSphere
anika.sharma@cloudsphere.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: cloudsphere_partner_credit_request_1102.csv
From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@cloudsphere.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner-issued sandbox credits for CloudSphere PLG integration

Anika — thanks for the clear ask and the CSV. This is the sort of partner-led onboarding we want to support. A few quick items we need to lock down before Ops can enact:

- Redemption artifact: will CloudSphere provide unique promo codes (preferred) or do you want Redwood to mint and hand them back?
- SKU & Accounting: need the SKU we should tie the credits to for internal chargebacks.
- Window & caps: confirm expiration and per-account cap (you mentioned single-use).
- Security: minimal data we need — partner ID, partner user email, customer org id. No PII beyond email.

I'll loop in marissa (partner ops) and dev (engineering ops) to scope implementation. Marissa — can you review the CSV and confirm we can support 250 redemptions with the proposed 20k token allocation? Dev — any red flags for the marketplace redemption flow or rate-limiting?

I can sign off on a standard pass-through config if the CSV looks clean. If you need Redwood to mint codes, we can do that but it adds 24–48 hours.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner-issued sandbox credits for CloudSphere PLG integration

Looping back after a quick review of the CSV and the signed MOA (attached). CSV looks consistent: columns for partner_id, account_email, requested_credits. A couple notes:

- We should validate emails at redemption time to prevent malformed entries.
- For accounting, SKU should be PARTY-SANDBOX-2026; tagging will let finance reconcile.
- Token allocation: I'll provision 5M token pool tied to the SKU and create a per-code cap of 20k tokens.

If Dev confirms there are no infra blockers, I recommend we proceed with CloudSphere issuing the codes and Redwood performing server-side validation only on redemption (i.e., we don't need to store the full CSV long-term).

Attachments: cloudsphere_signed_moa_1101.pdf

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@cloudsphere.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner-issued sandbox credits for CloudSphere PLG integration

Thanks — quick technical note from infra: we can support pass-through redemption where CloudSphere supplies codes and Redwood validates at redemption. Two operational caveats:

1) Rate limiting: 250 redemptions in short bursts could trigger anti-abuse thresholds. Recommend staggering issuance or pre-warming the redemption route.
2) Audit log: for compliance we'll log redemption events with partner_id and masked account_email (hash) — ok with CloudSphere?

If CloudSphere prefers Redwood-minted codes, we'll need an endpoint for bulk code provisioning; that takes an extra day but is straightforward.

Plan proposal:
- Marissa provisions SKU PARTY-SANDBOX-2026 and token pool 5M.
- CloudSphere issues codes starting Nov 6; Redwood validates and records masked emails.
- Ops monitors for spikes and pushes alerts to Slack #partner-ops.

Anika — confirm if masked-email logging is acceptable and whether you want staggered issuance.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Engineering, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@cloudsphere.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner-issued sandbox credits for CloudSphere PLG integration

Thanks team — that all works for us. Quick confirmations:

- CloudSphere will issue 250 unique promo codes on Nov 6, staggered in 5 batches of 50 over the first 24 hours.
- Masked-email logging is fine (we only require hashed email for anti-fraud); no need to store the CSV after issuance.
- We'll use the SKU PARTY-SANDBOX-2026 as requested.

Can you confirm when the redemption endpoint will be live and a sample redemption URL we can include in the marketplace listing? Also, please send the initial audit/metric dashboard link so our PMs can watch conversion.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get beta users in.

Best,
Anika

---
Redwood ops note (internal): redemption endpoint: https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/promos/redeem (live Nov 5 08:00 UTC). Dashboard: https://dash.redwoodinference.com/partners/HS-9072
